$$

after.worked_solution:
To find the area, we just need to compute the corresponding definite integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{\pi /2}^{3\pi /2}\operatorname{cos}⁡x\,\text{d}x & =\operatorname{sin}⁡x{|}_{\pi /2}^{3\pi /2} \\  & =\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2})-\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2}) \\  & =-1-(1) \\  & =-2\end{aligned}
$$

Since the region lies below the $x$-axis, we obtained a negative number. So the area that we want is $2.$
